_doc: L-corridor task (models/robotis_tb3/scene_corridor.xml). Units m and rad, world frame {W}. 'markers' is the EKF's known map. 'obstacles' and 'outline' describe the sim world: only src/robot/corridor.py and evaluation/ may read them, never src/estimation or src/control.
_sim_camera: the sim camera main.py uses for this task: the level URDF camera (fovy 48.8 deg, config/camera_sim.json). The lab camera (6.3 deg down) loses this corridor's 0.12 m dock marker at the stop (marker_lost), so it is not the default here

markers._doc: id -> [x, y, z, theta_M]: centre of the 0.10 m marker; theta_M = world heading of its normal (z axis)

dock._doc: All ranges are from the robot base origin (base_footprint), as aruco.measure() returns them. The docking controller uses stop_range_base only. stop_camera_to_marker is the same stop seen from the camera (0.076 m ahead of the base): the camera loses the marker closer than ~0.15 m.

obstacles._doc: centre [x, y] of the 0.3 x 0.3 m box; null = no obstacle. Free gap either side in m: left/right of the robot driving +y
